column1: # note: The 2025 Tax Rate Schedules (booklet page 35). Rate Schedule I, for single, head of household, married filing joint and widow(er) with dependent child; it is repeated for each status.
# note: Rows read "at least X but less than Y"; incomes are whole dollars, so each row ends one dollar below Y and the next starts over that dollar.
# note: The examples round the total tax to the nearest whole dollar.
# note: Hand-transcribed from the PDF and checked against its text twice.
